name: Cross-Attention
tagline: ClimaX default — a learnable query token attends to all variable tokens via multi-head cross-attention at each spatial location.
diff_from_baseline: Nguyen et al., ClimaX (ICML 2023). Default aggregation in ClimaX: a single learnable query attends across V variable tokens with multi-head attention to produce one fused token per spatial patch.

name: Learned Weighted Sum
tagline: Per-variable scalar weights normalized via softmax, then weighted sum across variable tokens.
diff_from_baseline: Standard attention-free fusion (cf. weighted feature fusion in FPN, multi-view aggregation). Learns one scalar per variable, softmax over V.

name: Mean Pooling
tagline: Simple average across the V variable tokens at each spatial location, no learnable parameters.
diff_from_baseline: Parameter-free permutation-invariant pool. Standard lower-bound aggregator.
